messages:
becky: Heads-up: ran into a nasty rotation edge in a customer's onboarding demo. CI rotated the canonical key but the running service kept authenticating with an older "legacy" env.

jorge: Which env names are in play?

becky: The deploy template had both REDWOOD_API_KEY and RW_LEGACY_TOKEN set. Our rotate job replaced REDWOOD_API_KEY only. The container still read RW_LEGACY_TOKEN at startup so rotation was effectively ignored.

elliot: Oof. Could be a pinned SDK with different env precedence. Quick repro?

becky: Yep. Repro steps:
```bash
export RW_LEGACY_TOKEN=old-secret
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=new-secret
# start server (uses env at process start)
./demo-server &
# rotate job only updates REDWOOD_API_KEY
# server still uses old-secret until restarted
```

jorge: Short-term patch: make our rotate helper update every known secret name when run from infra templates (REDWOOD_API_KEY, RW_LEGACY_TOKEN, RW_ORG_KEY, RW_PROJECT_KEY). That makes rotation idempotent even with older SDKs.

elliot: Agreed. Also add a compat shim in SDKs that logs a single-line deprecation warning if a legacy env is present, linking to the migration doc. Silent fails are the worst.

ops-bot: CI job #7721 failed: https://ci.internal/7721 401 unauthorized

becky: Long-term we need a canonical precedence RFC across languages: recommend REDWOOD_API_KEY as the single source of truth. If SDKs must support fallbacks for compatibility, they should prefer canonical and warn.

jorge: Also an operational note: containers rarely restart on secret rotation in many infra setups. Add a SIGHUP handler or a health-check-triggered restart in sample apps so clients re-init the auth client without manual intervention.

elliot: Streaming edgecase to call out: if auth happens at WS handshake and the token rotates mid-connection, some client implementations re-send credentials per-chunk while others reconnect. We should recommend handshake auth and fail-fast on auth error with guidance to reconnect. Document that in runtime guidelines.

doc-bot: Filed issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-templates/issues/209, https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/523 (compat shim + docs)

becky: Proposed immediate action items: 1) emergency rotate-helper patch to dual-write known env names (merge today), 2) sample apps: SIGHUP reload + small e2e to run rotate-and-assert, 3) SDKs: compat shim that emits deprecation warning and points to migration doc, 4) RFC for env precedence across SDKs + runtime streaming auth note.

jorge: I'll take the infra patch. elliot  can you add the e2e to demo CI?

elliot: On it, will PR in ~90 minutes.

becky: Thanks team. This one would have been a fun postmortem if it hit a customer during onboarding. :grimacing:
